source_identity_rule: Git SHA1 uses blob framing and is distinct from byte SHA256; neither is a distributable source archive digest. Metadata-only, bytes inspected in memory, no source imports. Matching release names are not compatibility evidence.

edges.decision_reason: Actual Generic fallback resolved; land transformation must remove nine FDM hydro force consumers, variant and mooring references.
Float hull tuning/host properties do not belong in selected land scope; remove coupled consumers too.
Ground surface/friction and compressed gear geometry affect land behavior; explicit new authoritative provider mapping required.
Aero and gear read damage variables; disabling feature does not itself prove zero neutral state or eliminate writers.
Sound callbacks/assets excluded; original warning presentation needs separately owned indication policy, not silence disguised as correct behavior.
Cabin/weather/EGT/door thermal properties can feed engine and static behavior; dependency proof before removal.
C182S-derived preheater; applied temperature offsets affect engine priming/oil, so specify inactive neutral offset and no activation path.
Ice factor writes propeller advance control; frozen dry normal scope must explicitly neutralize/exclude ice logic and preserve fixed-pitch semantics.
Depends on native FG pressure-derived CAS and POH-referenced error table; not interchangeable with raw auxiliary IAS.
Named function outputs change mass and aero; remove Nasal accumulation and all output consumers or define explicit dry neutral state.
Selected primary/alternate pressures feed native instruments; C182S-source comments require applicability review.
Water mooring forces and positioning handlers must be absent, not merely hidden controls.
External towbar reaction force consumers and attachment listeners must be absent for manual unassisted flight scope.
